micro.scope: Isolated production row-sync module and row CSS; 5000 synthetic rows, 1000 branch-like prefixes. Two independent pages/source. Within-page callback samples are correlated. Callback JS/layout only, no Native Git, whole Graph latency, CPU or retained-memory claim.

denseRenderer.scope: Actual Graph renderer/CSS and graphDelta/resize at 5000 rows, 1000 branches, 250 tags. Only the width module differs; common current fixture/other modules. Four independent browser/page lifetimes per source, B/A/A/B+A/B/B/A; within-page samples are correlated. CPU has its own 18-message/resize window after warmup, with stable complete Chromium PIDs and separate Node/Playwright usage. The original throttle session explicitly uses rate 1 throughout measured windows. No Native Git, actual button, VS Code host transport, aggregate memory or whole-operation latency claim.

excludedPreliminaryRenderer.qualification: Diagnostic only, excluded from final comparisons: one shared browser with a large first-page outlier, and CPU throttle was reset through a second CDP session that was then detached. The original throttle session was not explicitly configured to rate 1 for its entire life. The revised common harness sets the original session to rate 1, uses an independent browser for every page, and balances B/A/A/B+A/B/B/A. The production row-sync source is unchanged.

raw.scope: Actual Graph renderer/CSS and graphDelta/resize at 5000 rows, 1000 branches, 250 tags. Only the width module differs; common current fixture/other modules. Two independent pages/source; within-page samples are correlated. CPU has its own 18-message/resize window after warmup, with stable complete Chromium PIDs and separate Node/Playwright usage. No CPU throttling in measured windows. No Native Git, actual button, VS Code host transport, aggregate memory or whole-operation latency claim.
